headline: Ontology-driven knowledge graphs and metadata harmonization for FAIR omics resources
label: Fair Knowledge Graph Infrastructure
summary: Fragmented metabolic, metabolomics, and sequencing metadata now have RDF, ontology, and RO-Crate integration layers.
synthesis: The dominant thread is semantic structuring of biological metadata so that heterogeneous resources can be queried and integrated. PlantMetWiki represents 1,162 plant metabolic pathways as an RDF knowledge graph linked to BGC resources and exposes a public SPARQL endpoint for cross-species analysis. HARMONY applies an ontology-based framework to harmonize study metadata and metabolite identities across Metabolomics Workbench and MetaboLights, enabling unified discovery. bMINTY addresses a related problem at the local level, managing post-alignment sequencing outputs and their metadata and exporting queryable RO-Crate data packages. The distinguishing feature across these tools is the combination of formal ontologies, graph-based query interfaces, and standardized packaging for reproducible reuse. The items do not report comparative performance or benchmarking results.
